title: SR Data Extraction Plugin: a Chrome extension for AI-assisted, human-verified data extraction in systematic reviews
description: SR Data Extraction Plugin supports the data extraction step of systematic reviews. An LLM drafts the extraction form from the protocol and extracts each value with a verbatim quote; the quote is anchored to the PDF text layer and highlighted, and a human accepts, edits, rejects or marks every value as not reported, with all decisions kept as an audit trail. It also supports independent dual review with adjudication, risk-of-bias templates and CSV export. Google Sheets serves as the database and Google Drive stores the PDFs. Release notes for each version are in CHANGELOG.md.
